title: DART-Math: Difficulty-Aware Rejection Tuning for Mathematical Problem-Solving
authors_zh: Yuxuan Tong、Xiwen Zhang、Rui Wang、Ruidong Wu、Junxian He
paper_type_zh: 难度感知拒绝采样与开放数学 SFT 数据配方
best_for_zh: 研究数学推理数据构造、拒绝采样预算、答案 verifier 与 SFT 分布审计的读者
one_line: DART-Math converts MATH and corrected GSM8K training prompts into answer-verified CoT pairs by allocating more DeepSeekMath-7B-RL trials to queries with lower pass rates.
DART-Math 按 DeepSeekMath-7B-RL 的低通过率向 MATH 与修正版 GSM8K 难题分配更多采样，再用正则与 SymPy 终局答案检查筛成 CoT SFT 对；该 verifier 不验证中间推理。
why: It turns a usually hidden rejection-sampling budget into an auditable data-construction choice and demonstrates that coverage and difficulty distribution can matter independently of final dataset size.
inclusion_reason: DART-Math makes per-query sampling allocation and answer-level acceptance explicit in an open mathematical SFT recipe, while exposing how generator-relative difficulty changes the retained training distribution.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The official NeurIPS 2024 paper studies a construction defect in rejection-tuned mathematics data: sampling the same number of raw responses for every prompt yields many accepted responses for easy prompts but poor coverage of hard prompts. In the paper's MetaMathQA-MATH analysis, 51.1% of Level-5 MATH training queries receive no augmented response, even though sufficiently many DeepSeekMath-7B-RL trials can eventually find a correct answer for most sampled test questions (Paper §2, Figure 2).

DART-Math asks how a fixed inference budget should be distributed across the original MATH and corrected GSM8K training queries before supervised instruction tuning. One final training record is a query plus a natural-language response; the richer accepted-response pools also retain source and response IDs, ground-truth and extracted answers, correctness, generator and decoding metadata, while query-info tables retain sampling counts and pass rates. The feedback is terminal-answer agreement, not a judgment of every reasoning step.

This belongs in Data Construction and Open Release Recipes because its central intervention is the allocation and filtering pipeline that changes which verified traces survive. It does not introduce new questions, step labels, an interactive environment, code-execution reasoning, or an RLVR objective. The Card reaches L4 by grounding the recipe, release schemas, controlled VRT comparisons, code limitations, and open audit questions in the paper, appendix, repository, and official Hugging Face artifacts.

NeurIPS 2024 官方论文研究拒绝调优数学数据中的一种构造缺陷：若给每个 prompt 分配相同数量的原始响应，简单题会留下许多通过验证的回答，而难题覆盖不足。论文对 MetaMathQA-MATH 的分析显示，51.1% 的 MATH Level-5 训练题没有获得任何新增响应；但只要对部分测试题投入足够多的 DeepSeekMath-7B-RL 试验，最终通常仍能采样到正确答案（论文 §2，Figure 2）。

DART-Math 研究在 supervised instruction tuning 之前，如何把固定推理预算分配给原始 MATH 与修正版 GSM8K 训练题。最终训练记录是一组 query 与自然语言 response；更丰富的已接受响应池还保留来源与响应 ID、参考答案与抽取答案、正确性、生成器和解码元数据，query-info 表则保留采样计数与通过率。反馈只判断终局答案是否一致，并不判断每个推理步骤。

它属于 Data Construction and Open Release Recipes，因为核心干预是改变哪些已验证轨迹能留下来的预算分配与过滤流水线。它不生成新题，不提供步骤标签，不使用交互环境或代码执行推理，也不采用 RLVR 目标。本 Card 以论文、附录、仓库和官方 Hugging Face artifact 为依据，覆盖配方、发布 schema、受控 VRT 对比、代码边界与未解决审计项，因此达到 L4。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution is to control the distribution of accepted reasoning traces by query difficulty rather than to replace the answer checker. Vanilla rejection tuning fixes the number of raw trials per query and retains whichever candidates pass. DARS-Uniform instead samples until every query has a target of k_u accepted responses; DARS-Prop2Diff assigns an accepted-response target proportional to difficulty, capped at k_p for the hardest queries, while attempting to preserve at least one synthetic response for every query. The final recipes use k_u=40 and k_p=192 and produce DART-Math-Uniform and DART-Math-Hard (Paper §3.2–§3.3).

Difficulty is measured by failure rate under DeepSeekMath-7B-RL. The paper body defines this as the proportion of incorrect responses; the official repository operationalizes it as 1-pass_rate. That signal controls more sampling, not a scalar training reward. A regex/SymPy pipeline observes the generated text's extractable final answer and the reference answer, but cannot observe whether intermediate equations are valid, whether the rationale is faithful, or whether a correct result was reached through a shortcut.

The closest baseline is equal-raw-budget vanilla rejection tuning (VRT) at the same roughly 590k retained examples. MetaMathQA is the motivating public dataset whose accepted responses skew toward easier MATH prompts, while ToRA and MARIO previously increased sampling to improve coverage. DART's concrete difference is to target the retained per-query distribution explicitly and publish final SFT sets plus accepted-response pools and per-query sampling statistics; unlike process-supervision work, its native label remains answer-level.

本文的贡献是按题目难度控制最终接受的推理轨迹分布，而不是替换答案 checker。vanilla rejection tuning 为每题固定原始试验数，只保留其中通过验证的候选；DARS-Uniform 改为持续采样，直到每题达到 k_u 个已接受响应；DARS-Prop2Diff 则按难度分配已接受响应目标，最难题的上限为 k_p，同时尽量保证每题至少有一条合成响应。最终配方取 k_u=40、k_p=192，分别构成 DART-Math-Uniform 与 DART-Math-Hard（论文 §3.2–§3.3）。

难度由 DeepSeekMath-7B-RL 的失败率衡量。论文正文把它定义为错误响应占比，官方仓库将其落实为 1-pass_rate。该信号只控制增加多少采样，并不是训练时的 scalar reward。正则/SymPy 流水线能观察生成文本中可抽取的最终答案与参考答案，却看不到中间等式是否成立、rationale 是否忠实，或正确结果是否来自捷径。

最接近的基线是保留样本数同为约 590k、但每题原始预算相同的 vanilla rejection tuning（VRT）。MetaMathQA 是动机分析中的公开数据集，其已接受响应偏向更简单的 MATH 题；ToRA 与 MARIO 也曾通过增加采样改善覆盖。DART 的具体差别是显式设定每题最终保留数量的分布，并发布最终 SFT 集、已接受响应池与逐题采样统计；与 process supervision 不同，它的原生标签仍是答案级。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs are the original MATH training queries and the authors' corrected GSM8K training queries. DeepSeekMath-7B-RL generates zero-shot natural-language CoT responses through vLLM with a 2,048-token output cap, top-p 0.95, and temperature 1.6. Appendix B.2 reports choosing 1.6 after a 0.3–1.8 sweep at 0.1 intervals: higher temperatures reached coverage faster, while settings at least 1.7 produced nonsensical output. The generation model is also the difficulty-estimation model.

Each raw response goes through final-answer extraction based on regular expressions and then SymPy-based comparison with the reference. The implementation covers numbers, symbols, matrices/vectors, intervals, Boolean expressions, dates, and times. Passing supplies an answer-level Boolean acceptance label; no intermediate step receives a label. The paper explicitly warns that final-answer correctness need not imply intermediate-reasoning correctness (Paper §2.1 note 2; Appendix B.2).

Allocation has three alternatives. VRT samples 52 raw trials per query in the repository's reproduction command and retains correct ones. Uniform samples toward 40 correct responses per query in the final release. For the larger pool used to estimate pass rates, Appendix B.2 instead reports collecting toward 192 correct responses per query and reusing those candidates. Prop2Diff computes 1-pass_rate, turns it into a target up to 192 accepted responses for the hardest prompts, rounds upward to preserve at least one synthetic response where possible, and keeps sampling until the target or a practical cap is reached. The paper reports about 150 million raw samples, over 95% target attainment, and about 160 A100 GPU-days; the repository acknowledges that exact Prop2Diff reproduction still requires manual steps.

Accepted synthetic responses are combined with the original MATH/GSM8K training records. DART-Math-Hard and DART-Math-Uniform expose train-only query/response tables; at the checked revisions they contain 585,392 and 590,705 rows. Supplementary pools expose accepted-response provenance and correctness fields, and query-info releases expose per-job/total sample counts, correct counts, pass rate, and Bernoulli standard deviation. Complete rejected-response text is not established as released.

Training uses the Alpaca instruction template and Transformers SFT with sequence packing to 4,096 tokens, batch size 64 computation sequences, Adam with zero weight decay, 3% warmup, and cosine decay. Reported maximum learning rates are 1e-5 for Mistral-7B, 5e-5 for DeepSeekMath-7B and Llama3-8B, and 2e-5 for Llama3-70B; Llama3 runs use one epoch and the default elsewhere is three. Reproduction should pin the GitHub commit, every HF revision, corrected GSM8K revision, model checkpoint, random seeds, parser/SymPy versions, and exact Prop2Diff caps and curation manifest.

输入是原始 MATH 训练题和作者修正后的 GSM8K 训练题。DeepSeekMath-7B-RL 通过 vLLM 以零样本自然语言 CoT 方式生成响应，输出上限为 2,048 token，top-p 为 0.95，temperature 为 1.6。附录 B.2 说明，作者以 0.1 为步长在 0.3–1.8 之间搜索后选定 1.6：较高 temperature 更快达到覆盖，而不低于 1.7 时会出现无意义输出。该生成模型也负责估计难度。

每条原始响应先经正则表达式抽取最终答案，再用 SymPy 与参考答案比较。实现覆盖数字、符号、矩阵/向量、区间、Boolean 表达式、日期和时间。通过验证只产生答案级 Boolean 接受标签；任何中间步骤都没有标签。论文明确提醒，最终答案正确不必然意味着中间推理正确（论文 §2.1 注 2；附录 B.2）。

预算分配有三种方案。仓库中的 VRT 复现命令为每题采样 52 个原始试验并保留正确项；最终 Uniform 发布以每题 40 个正确响应为目标。对于用于估计通过率的更大 pool，附录 B.2 则报告以每题 192 个正确响应为收集目标，并复用这些候选。Prop2Diff 计算 1-pass_rate，将其转换为已接受响应目标，最难题最多 192 条，并向上取整以尽量保证每题至少一条合成响应，然后采样到目标或实际试验上限。论文报告约 1.5 亿个原始样本、超过 95% 的目标达成率和约 160 个 A100 GPU-day；仓库同时承认，精确复现 Prop2Diff 仍需人工步骤。

通过验证的合成响应会与原始 MATH/GSM8K 训练记录合并。DART-Math-Hard 与 DART-Math-Uniform 只提供 train split 的 query/response 表；在本次核验的 revision 上分别为 585,392 与 590,705 行。补充 pool 暴露已接受响应的沿袭与正确性字段，query-info 发布则包含逐 job/总采样数、正确数、通过率和 Bernoulli 标准差。尚不能确认完整的被拒响应文本已经发布。

训练采用 Alpaca instruction template 和 Transformers SFT，sequence packing 长度为 4,096 token，batch size 为 64 个 computation sequence，Adam 的 weight decay 为 0，warmup ratio 为 3%，再做 cosine decay。报告的最大学习率为：Mistral-7B 取 1e-5，DeepSeekMath-7B 与 Llama3-8B 取 5e-5，Llama3-70B 取 2e-5；Llama3 训练一轮，其他 DART 运行默认三轮。复现时应固定 GitHub commit、全部 HF revision、修正版 GSM8K revision、模型 checkpoint、随机种子、parser/SymPy 版本，以及 Prop2Diff 的精确上限与 curation manifest。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The cleanest evidence is the equal-size comparison against VRT in Table 2. With 0.59M retained examples and greedy natural-language evaluation on six benchmarks, Llama3-8B VRT averages 35.2, Uniform 38.7, and Prop2Diff 39.7. Mistral-7B moves from 34.3 under VRT to 37.4 under Uniform and 38.8 under Prop2Diff. On MATH specifically, Prop2Diff improves Llama3-8B from 39.7 to 46.6 and Mistral-7B from 38.7 to 45.5. These are author-reported SFT results under the training/evaluation setup in Appendix B, not an independent reproduction.

The result is conditional rather than universal. For DeepSeekMath-7B, VRT/Uniform/Prop2Diff averages are 48.3/49.2/49.4; for Llama3-70B they are 48.5/49.1/49.3. Prop2Diff also lowers GSM8K relative to VRT for Llama3-8B (81.1 versus 81.7), DeepSeekMath-7B (86.8 versus 88.2), and Llama3-70B (89.6 versus 90.3). The authors therefore report larger gains on general 7–8B bases and difficult benchmarks, with smaller effects on strong or math-specialized bases and easy GSM8K (Paper §4.2, Table 2).

Coverage evidence isolates the intended distributional effect. Appendix Table 4 reports 99.6% coverage of MATH training queries for both DART-Math sets, versus 84.9% for the equal-size VRT baseline and 82.8% for MetaMath-MATH-AnsAug; Level-5 coverage is 99.1%, 62.9%, and 48.9%, respectively. Figure 4 further reports that removing the one-response coverage rule costs about eight GSM8K points at small data scale, while the gap shrinks as the dataset grows.

Official artifacts corroborate the release object: the checked Hard and Uniform revisions expose 585,392 and 590,705 two-column SFT rows, and the pool/query-info datasets expose accepted-response lineage and sampling statistics. They do not prove that all rationales are correct, licensed, diverse, or uncontaminated. Benchmark gains support the tested allocation recipe; they are not evidence of process-label quality.

最直接的证据是 Table 2 与 VRT 的等规模对比。在保留样本同为 0.59M、六个 benchmark 均使用贪心自然语言评测的条件下，Llama3-8B 的平均分从 VRT 35.2 提升到 Uniform 38.7、Prop2Diff 39.7；Mistral-7B 则从 VRT 34.3 提升到 Uniform 37.4、Prop2Diff 38.8。在 MATH 上，Prop2Diff 把 Llama3-8B 从 39.7 提升到 46.6，把 Mistral-7B 从 38.7 提升到 45.5。这些是作者在附录 B 所述训练/评测设置下报告的 SFT 结果，并非独立复现。

该结果有明确条件，并非普遍成立。DeepSeekMath-7B 的 VRT/Uniform/Prop2Diff 平均分为 48.3/49.2/49.4，Llama3-70B 为 48.5/49.1/49.3。Prop2Diff 在 GSM8K 上还低于 VRT：Llama3-8B 为 81.1 对 81.7，DeepSeekMath-7B 为 86.8 对 88.2，Llama3-70B 为 89.6 对 90.3。因此，作者报告的增益主要出现在通用 7–8B base 与较难 benchmark；对强模型、数学专用模型和较简单的 GSM8K，效果更小（论文 §4.2，Table 2）。

覆盖证据更直接对应预期的分布变化。附录 Table 4 报告两种 DART-Math 数据对 MATH 训练题的覆盖率均为 99.6%，同规模 VRT 为 84.9%，MetaMath-MATH-AnsAug 为 82.8%；Level-5 覆盖率分别为 99.1%、62.9% 和 48.9%。Figure 4 还显示，在小数据规模下取消“每题至少一条响应”的规则会使 GSM8K 下降约 8 分，而数据规模增大后差距缩小。

官方 artifact 也核实了发布对象：本次检查的 Hard 与 Uniform revision 分别提供 585,392 与 590,705 行双列 SFT 数据，pool/query-info 数据则暴露已接受响应的沿袭与采样统计。但它们不能证明所有 rationale 都正确、合规、多样或无污染。benchmark 增益支持所测试的预算分配配方，不是过程标签质量的证据。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier rejection-tuning pipelines such as the MetaMathQA augmentation analyzed by the authors sample a fixed number of raw responses per query, then let the verifier's varying pass rate determine how many examples each prompt contributes. This makes the retained distribution an accidental function of prompt difficulty: hard prompts can disappear even when the generator could solve them with more trials.

DART changes the selection target. Uniform equalizes accepted responses per query, while Prop2Diff makes accepted count proportional to the generator-relative failure rate and separately enforces coverage. The new data object is not a different kind of rationale and the feedback interface remains final-answer checking; the concrete contribution is making allocation, target attainment, and per-query sampling metadata first-class parts of the construction recipe.

ToRA and MARIO had already spent extra computation on unsolved problems, and DART reuses standard CoT generation, rejection filtering, and SFT. The paper's Appendix A argues that those predecessors primarily optimize coverage, whereas DART explicitly controls the final difficulty distribution. This is a methodological change rather than merely a larger corpus: both DART datasets remain around 590k, and the comparison holds retained size fixed against VRT.

For reasoning-data research, the direction is important because it separates three quantities that are often conflated: raw generation trials, unique prompts covered, and accepted training responses. Reuse still requires checking whether the difficulty estimate transfers to another generator, whether parser errors correlate with difficulty, and whether gains persist after aligning raw synthesis compute—not only final dataset size.

作者分析的 MetaMathQA 增广等早期 rejection-tuning 流水线，会先给每题固定数量的原始响应，再让 verifier 随题目变化的通过率决定每个 prompt 最终贡献多少样本。这样，保留分布就意外地受题目难度支配：即使生成器投入更多试验后能够解出某道难题，该题仍可能从合成数据中消失。

DART 改变的是筛选目标。Uniform 让每题的已接受响应数相同；Prop2Diff 让已接受数量与生成器相关的失败率成比例，并另行保证覆盖。新数据对象并不是另一种 rationale，反馈接口仍是最终答案检查；具体贡献是把预算分配、目标达成率和逐题采样元数据提升为构造配方的一等要素。

ToRA 与 MARIO 已经会在未解题上投入额外计算，DART 也复用了标准 CoT 生成、rejection filtering 和 SFT。论文附录 A 的区分是：这些前序方法主要优化覆盖，而 DART 显式控制最终难度分布。因此，它不是单纯扩大语料：两个 DART 数据集仍约为 590k，并且与 VRT 的比较固定了最终保留规模。

对 reasoning-data 研究而言，这一方向的意义在于分开三个经常混淆的量：原始生成试验数、覆盖的唯一 prompt 数，以及最终接受的训练响应数。复用前仍需检查：难度估计能否迁移到其他生成器、parser 错误是否与难度相关，以及在对齐原始合成计算量而不只是最终数据规模后，增益是否仍存在。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The outcome verifier is the central modeling limitation. Regex extraction and SymPy equivalence can reject a valid answer rendered in an unsupported form or accept a response whose final value matches by accident; neither operation validates the intermediate CoT. The paper explicitly declines to distinguish answer correctness from process correctness. No calibrated false-accept/false-reject study or adversarial formatting test is reported.

Difficulty and budget are not intrinsic prompt properties. They depend on DeepSeekMath-7B-RL, temperature 1.6, top-p 0.95, the answer checker, and the number of trials. The paper body defines fail rate as the proportion incorrect, but Appendix B.2 displays an inconsistent equation; the repository clarifies 1-pass_rate. The repository also says Prop2Diff still needs manual effort, and its public Uniform example uses potentially unbounded trials that must be stopped manually. Exact reported caps, seeds, scheduling, and immutable environment files are not fully pinned.

Release metadata is asymmetric. Final SFT sets contain only query and response; accepted-response pools and query-info tables restore useful provenance and aggregate sampling counts, but complete rejected-response text is not established. This prevents independent inspection of checker mistakes, repeated failure modes, and how many distinct bad rationales were discarded. The pool field proc_correct_prob is null, consistent with the absence of process supervision.

Source and evaluation audits remain partial. The authors correct erroneous GSM8K labels and release gsm8k-fix, yet the paper does not provide an independent label audit or a complete change rationale. No semantic deduplication or pretraining-overlap analysis is reported. MATH and GSM8K supply both training prompts and in-domain test surfaces, and the four out-of-domain evaluations do not remove possible model-pretraining contamination.

The code and DART Hugging Face cards declare MIT, but this does not by itself establish compatible rights for every upstream MATH/GSM8K item or synthetic derivative. The checked GitHub repository has no tagged release, while datasets and models are separate mutable repositories. Reusers need immutable revisions, source-level licensing, a row manifest, and dependency/parser versions before treating the release as fully reproducible training data.

outcome verifier 是首要建模限制。正则抽取与 SymPy 等价判断可能拒绝以未支持形式表达的正确答案，也可能接受最终数值偶然一致的响应；两者都不验证中间 CoT。论文明确不进一步区分答案正确与过程正确，也未报告经过校准的假接受/假拒绝研究或对抗格式测试。

难度与预算并不是 prompt 的固有属性。它们依赖 DeepSeekMath-7B-RL、temperature 1.6、top-p 0.95、答案 checker 和试验次数。论文正文把 fail rate 定义为错误响应占比，但附录 B.2 的展示公式与此不一致；仓库用 1-pass_rate 加以明确。仓库也说明 Prop2Diff 仍需人工步骤，其公开 Uniform 示例甚至使用需人工停止的潜在无界试验。报告运行所用的精确上限、随机种子、调度与不可变环境文件并未完整固定。

发布元数据并不对称。最终 SFT 集只有 query 与 response；已接受响应池和 query-info 表补充了有用沿袭与聚合采样计数，但尚不能确认完整的被拒响应文本已发布。因此，外部人员无法独立检查 checker 错误、重复失败模式，以及究竟丢弃了多少种不同的错误 rationale。pool 中的 proc_correct_prob 为 null，也与没有过程监督这一事实一致。

来源与评测审计仍不完整。作者修正了错误 GSM8K 标签并发布 gsm8k-fix，但论文没有提供独立标签审计或完整变更理由。论文也未报告语义去重或预训练重叠分析。MATH 与 GSM8K 同时提供训练 prompt 和域内测试面，而四个域外评测也不能排除模型预训练污染。

代码与 DART Hugging Face card 声明 MIT，但这本身不能证明每个上游 MATH/GSM8K 条目及其合成衍生物都具有兼容权利。本次检查的 GitHub 仓库没有 tagged release，各数据集和模型又位于独立的可变仓库。复用者还需固定 revision、来源级许可证、逐行 manifest，以及依赖和 parser 版本，才能把该发布视为完整可复现的训练数据。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the assigned Data Construction and Open Release Recipes track, DART-Math is a reusable blueprint for studying how a fixed generation budget becomes a training distribution. A controlled replication can hold prompts, generator, verifier, retained size, and SFT hyperparameters fixed while varying equal-raw-budget VRT, equal-accepted-count Uniform, and difficulty-proportional Prop2Diff. Researchers should report both raw synthesis compute and retained examples, because the paper's 590k-size control does not equalize the roughly 150 million raw trials spent by the reported DART run.

The final query/response sets are directly usable for answer-level math SFT, subject to upstream-license, overlap, and snapshot review. The pools and query-info tables are more useful for construction research: they support reallocation experiments, generator-relative difficulty studies, checker audits, and analyses of coverage versus repeated responses. They do not support process-supervision claims because they contain no validated step labels.

A stronger reuse protocol would pin source and release revisions; keep all raw candidates, extracted answers, checker decisions, and retry counts; validate a stratified sample with a second symbolic or human checker; compare multiple generators; and publish semantic-overlap results. Prop2Diff should be implemented as a deterministic script whose target calculation, rounding, raw cap, and seed are versioned rather than reconstructed manually from prose.

Reuse class: suitable for guarded SFT and construction-policy experiments after license/snapshot checks; suitable now as an audit and replication reference. It is not safe to treat the rationales as process-correct labels, and benchmark performance alone does not clear contamination, lineage, or verifier-robustness concerns.

对本次分配的 Data Construction and Open Release Recipes track，DART-Math 是研究“固定生成预算如何变成训练分布”的可复用蓝图。受控复现实验可以固定 prompt、生成器、verifier、最终保留规模和 SFT 超参数，仅改变三种分配：原始预算相同的 VRT、接受数量相同的 Uniform，以及难度成比例的 Prop2Diff。研究者应同时报告原始合成计算量与最终样本量，因为论文固定约 590k 最终样本，并不等于对齐报告 DART 运行所花费的约 1.5 亿次原始试验。

最终 query/response 数据在完成上游许可证、重叠与 snapshot 审查后，可直接用于答案级数学 SFT。pool 与 query-info 表更适合构造研究，可用于重新分配实验、生成器相关难度研究、checker 审计，以及覆盖率与重复响应数的分析。由于没有经过验证的步骤标签，它们不能支持 process supervision 声明。

更强的复用协议应固定来源与发布 revision；保留所有原始候选、抽取答案、checker 决策和重试计数；用第二个符号 checker 或人工审查分层样本；比较多个生成器；并发布语义重叠结果。Prop2Diff 应实现为确定性脚本，把目标计算、取整、原始试验上限与随机种子全部版本化，而不是由复用者根据文字手工重建。

复用等级：通过许可证与 snapshot 检查后，可谨慎用于 SFT 与构造策略实验；当前可作为审计和复现参考。不能把这些 rationale 当成过程正确标签，benchmark 表现也不能单独消除污染、沿袭或 verifier 稳健性风险。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read §3.2–§3.3 with Appendix B.2: k_u=40, k_p=192, temperature 1.6, and 1-pass_rate define the construction semantics more precisely than the abstract.
  • Keep three budgets separate: raw trials, accepted responses, and unique prompt coverage; equal 590k final size does not mean equal synthesis compute.
  • Table 2 shows large gains for Mistral-7B/Llama3-8B but roughly one-point average gains for DeepSeekMath-7B/Llama3-70B and several GSM8K regressions.
  • The final datasets are only query/response; inspect pool and query-info releases for provenance and sampling metadata, while noting that complete rejected-response text is not established.
  • Do not read regex/SymPy terminal-answer acceptance as process supervision; the paper itself states that answer correctness need not imply intermediate-reasoning correctness.
  • Reproduction should resolve the appendix fail-rate inconsistency and the repository's manual Prop2Diff steps before comparing implementations.

• 将 §3.2–§3.3 与附录 B.2 对照阅读：k_u=40、k_p=192、temperature 1.6 与 1-pass_rate 比摘要更准确地界定构造语义。
  • 区分三种预算：原始试验数、已接受响应数和唯一 prompt 覆盖；最终同为约 590k 不代表合成计算量相同。
  • Table 2 显示 Mistral-7B/Llama3-8B 增益较大，但 DeepSeekMath-7B/Llama3-70B 平均只提升约 1 分，并且多个 GSM8K 结果下降。
  • 最终数据集只有 query/response；沿袭与采样元数据要查看 pool 和 query-info 发布，同时注意完整被拒响应文本尚不能确认已发布。
  • 不要把正则/SymPy 终局答案接受误读成 process supervision；论文自己说明答案正确不必然意味着中间推理正确。
  • 比较复现实现之前，应先解决附录 fail-rate 不一致和仓库中 Prop2Diff 仍需手工步骤的问题。

value.html: Original MATH training queries and the authors' corrected GSM8K training queries; original human solutions are also appended to the final SFT datasets.

value_zh.html: 原始 MATH 训练查询与作者校正的 GSM8K 训练查询；原始人工解答也附加到最终 SFT 数据集。

value.html: The final DART-Math-Hard and DART-Math-Uniform rows are query/response pairs. Supplementary accepted-response pools retain query provenance, ground-truth answer, generated response, extracted answer, answer-correctness flag, decoding metadata, query_id, and resp_id; separate query-info rows retain sampling counts and pass-rate statistics.

value_zh.html: 最终 DART-Math-Hard 与 DART-Math-Uniform 行是 query/response 对。补充的已接受回复池保留查询溯源、标准答案、生成回复、抽取答案、答案正确性标志、解码元数据、query_id 与 resp_id；单独的 query-info 行保留采样计数与通过率统计。

value.html: DeepSeekMath-7B-RL generates natural-language chain-of-thought responses without tool execution.

value_zh.html: DeepSeekMath-7B-RL 生成自然语言思维链回复，不执行工具。

value.html: Offline vLLM sampling, regex/SymPy terminal-answer grading, difficulty-aware allocation, curation, then supervised instruction tuning; no interactive environment or code-execution trace is part of the released SFT record.

value_zh.html: 离线 vLLM 采样、regex/SymPy 终端答案评分、难度感知分配、策展，然后监督指令调优；已发布 SFT 记录不含交互环境或代码执行轨迹。

value.html: A repository implementation extracts final answers with regular expressions and uses SymPy-based symbolic judgment for numbers, symbols, matrices/vectors, intervals, Boolean expressions, dates, and times. It supplies a Boolean answer-level acceptance signal and does not verify intermediate reasoning.

value_zh.html: 仓库实现用正则表达式抽取最终答案，并对数字、符号、矩阵/向量、区间、布尔表达式、日期与时间使用基于 SymPy 的符号判定。它提供布尔答案级接受信号，不核验中间推理。

value.html: A candidate is retained when its extracted terminal answer is judged equivalent to the reference answer; sampling for a query stops when the strategy's target number of correct responses is met or the practical raw-trial cap is reached.

value_zh.html: 当所抽取终端答案被判定与参考答案等价时保留该候选；当达到该策略的目标正确回复数或实际原始尝试上限时，对该查询停止采样。

value.html: Downstream SFT is evaluated on Mistral-7B, DeepSeekMath-7B, Llama3-8B, and Llama3-70B base models.

value_zh.html: 下游 SFT 在 Mistral-7B、DeepSeekMath-7B、Llama3-8B 与 Llama3-70B 基座模型上评测。

value.html: DeepSeekMath-7B-RL is the sole response generator and the sampling model used to estimate query difficulty.

value_zh.html: DeepSeekMath-7B-RL 是唯一回复生成器，也是用于估计查询难度的采样模型。

value.html: DeepSeekMath-7B-RL through vLLM with a natural-language CoT prompt.

value_zh.html: DeepSeekMath-7B-RL 通过 vLLM 使用自然语言 CoT 提示。

value.html: Maximum 2,048 output tokens, top-p 0.95, temperature 1.6. Temperature was selected from a 0.3–1.8 sweep in 0.1 increments. The final datasets append original MATH/GSM8K training examples to accepted synthetic responses.

value_zh.html: 最大 2,048 个输出 token、top-p 0.95、temperature 1.6。temperature 从 0.3–1.8、步长 0.1 的扫描中选出。最终数据集将原始 MATH/GSM8K 训练示例附加到已接受的合成回复。

value.html: Variable by query and strategy. The authors report approximately 150 million raw samples in the full synthesis run; per-query raw caps and realized counts are recorded only partially in released metadata.

value_zh.html: 随查询与策略而变。作者报告完整合成运行中约 150 million 条原始样本；逐查询原始上限与实现计数仅部分记录于已发布元数据。

value.html: Accept only responses passing regex extraction and SymPy/reference-answer judgment. DARS-Uniform targets 40 correct responses per query; DARS-Prop2Diff assigns a target proportional to 1-pass_rate, up to 192 for the hardest queries, while attempting to preserve at least one synthetic response per query.

value_zh.html: 仅接受通过 regex 抽取与 SymPy/参考答案判定的回复。DARS-Uniform 每查询目标为 40 条正确回复；DARS-Prop2Diff 按 1-pass_rate 成比例分配目标，最难查询至多 192，同时试图为每查询至少保留一条合成回复。

value.html: About 35,000 raw samples per A100 GPU-hour in the reported setup; approximately 160 A100 GPU-days for about 150 million raw samples and an over-95% target-achievement ratio.

value_zh.html: 所报告设置中每 A100 GPU-hour 约 35,000 条原始样本；约 160 A100 GPU-days 用于约 150 million 条原始样本以及超过 95% 的目标达成率。

value.html: Transformers SFT with sequence packing to length 4,096, batch size 64 computation sequences, Adam with zero weight decay, 3% linear warmup and cosine schedule. Maximum learning rates are 1e-5 for Mistral-7B, 5e-5 for DeepSeekMath-7B/Llama3-8B, and 2e-5 for Llama3-70B; Llama3 models use one epoch and the default for other DART runs is three.

value_zh.html: Transformers SFT 将序列打包至长度 4,096，batch size 为 64 个计算序列，Adam 权重衰减为零、3% 线性 warmup 与余弦调度。最大学习率为 Mistral-7B 的 1e-5、DeepSeekMath-7B/Llama3-8B 的 5e-5 与 Llama3-70B 的 2e-5；Llama3 模型使用一个 epoch，其他 DART 运行默认三个。

value.html: Synthetic responses generated from fixed MATH and corrected GSM8K training queries, plus the original human-annotated training responses. Exact MATH/GSM8K proportions in each final release are not stated in the final two-column schema.

value_zh.html: 由固定 MATH 与校正 GSM8K 训练查询生成的合成回复，外加原始人工标注训练回复。最终两列 schema 未说明各最终发布中精确的 MATH/GSM8K 比例。

value.html: The official DART-Math-Hard and DART-Math-Uniform repositories expose train-only splits with 585,392 and 590,705 rows at the checked revisions. No separate development split or immutable paper-level manifest is disclosed.

value_zh.html: 官方 DART-Math-Hard 与 DART-Math-Uniform 仓库在所核修订上暴露仅含 train 的划分，分别为 585,392 与 590,705 行。未披露单独的开发划分或不可变论文级清单。

value.html: No semantic deduplication, pretraining-overlap audit, or explicit decontamination against MATH, GSM8K, CollegeMath, DeepMind Mathematics, OlympiadBench-Math, or TheoremQA is reported. Evaluation uses MATH/GSM8K test splits and four stated out-of-domain benchmarks.

value_zh.html: 未报告针对 MATH、GSM8K、CollegeMath、DeepMind Mathematics、OlympiadBench-Math 或 TheoremQA 的语义去重、预训练重叠审计或显式去污染。评测使用 MATH/GSM8K 测试划分与四个所述域外基准。

items: Final-answer equivalence can accept a response with invalid, contradictory, or unfaithful intermediate reasoning.
Regex extraction and symbolic normalization can produce false positives or false negatives; the paper does not report a calibrated parser/judge error study.
Difficulty is relative to DeepSeekMath-7B-RL, temperature 1.6, the checker, and the sampling budget, so the allocation need not transfer to another generator.
The paper body defines fail rate as the proportion incorrect, but the appendix's displayed formula is inconsistent; the official README clarifies 1-pass_rate.
The official README says Prop2Diff reproduction still requires manual effort, so the published repository is not a one-command reconstruction of the reported Hard dataset.
Erroneous GSM8K labels can corrupt acceptance; the authors publish gsm8k-fix, but a complete change ledger and independent label audit are not documented in the paper.
The accepted-response pools and aggregate query counts do not substitute for the complete rejected-response text needed to audit checker errors and selection bias.
Benchmark overlap, upstream rights, exact run seeds, dependency versions, and immutable model/data manifests remain incompletely documented.
最终答案等价可能接受中间推理无效、矛盾或不忠实的回复。
正则抽取与符号规范化可能产生假阳性或假阴性；论文未报告经校准的解析器/评审模型误差研究。
难度相对于 DeepSeekMath-7B-RL、temperature 1.6、检查器与采样预算，因此该分配不必迁移到另一生成器。
论文正文将失败率定义为不正确的比例，但附录所示公式不一致；官方 README 澄清为 1-pass_rate。
官方 README 称 Prop2Diff 复现仍需人工努力，因此已发布仓库并非所报告 Hard 数据集的一键重构。
错误的 GSM8K 标签可能破坏接受判定；作者发布 gsm8k-fix，但完整变更账本与独立标签审计未在论文中记录。
已接受回复池与汇总查询计数不能替代审计检查器错误与选择偏差所需的完整被拒绝回复文本。
基准重叠、上游权利、精确运行种子、依赖版本与不可变模型/数据清单仍记录不完整。

value.html: The code repository and official DART Hugging Face cards declare MIT. Compatibility and attribution obligations for upstream MATH/GSM8K content and synthetic derivatives require a separate source-level review.

value_zh.html: 代码仓库与官方 DART Hugging Face 卡片声明 MIT。上游 MATH/GSM8K 内容与合成衍生的兼容性及署名义务需单独进行来源级审阅。

value.html: MATH or corrected GSM8K training row -> DeepSeekMath-7B-RL candidates -> regex/SymPy answer decisions -> per-query pass-rate/count metadata -> Uniform or Prop2Diff allocation -> accepted synthetic response plus original training responses -> two-column SFT release. Pool artifacts preserve accepted-response lineage IDs, but complete rejected-response text is not established.
